abilities.name: Burst
abilities.text: Choose a point within 6 units; Sphere with hex radius 1 (7 hexes); vs. Fortitude. On success, each affected enemy suffers 1 Physical Force Damage. Surge 2: choose one successfully affected creature to suffer +1 Damage.

abilities.name: Scatter
abilities.text: After Burst resolves, move each successfully affected creature 1 unit directly away from the Sphere center if that space is legal.

system.gmNotes:
Role use. Discourage clustering and create a reason to spread out. Do not combine several Blasters unless the battlefield gives players enough room to respond.

Starting Enemy Example (Essence v0.6, Part XIV). Playtest reference; change its fictional presentation freely.
